products.name: AIVA
products.note: Classical music AI composer; copyright assignment; EU-hosted; commercial licensing

profile_text.body:
AIVA Technologies operates the AIVA platform, which the company describes as an AI music generation assistant. According to its own site, AIVA allows users to generate new songs in more than 250 different styles within seconds, and the company positions it as suitable for both complete beginners and seasoned music professionals.

The held facts classify AIVA under the Voice and Audio category and note that the product functions as a classical music AI composer with commercial licensing available, copyright assignment provisions, and EU-hosted infrastructure.
